description: Explore, compare, iterate, and export interactive UI design prototypes from the Design app.

auth.setup: Authenticate with the Design MCP connector in the host app or use agent-native app-skill ensure to register the URL-only connector.

interface.longDescription: Create interactive prototypes in your Agent-Native Design workspace. Browse saved designs, templates, design systems, and snapshots; start new designs, generate visual directions, and refine saved prototypes through chat. This connection works with designs in the connected Agent-Native workspace. It does not connect to local repositories, modify a running website, export files, or deploy an application.
defaultPrompt: Prototype a checkout flow for a mobile-friendly outdoor gear store.
Create a polished sales dashboard for a neighborhood bakery with daily revenue, top-selling items, and staffing needs.
Create a landing page and show three visual directions.

positive.prompt: Create a responsive landing page for a neighborhood bakery, with a menu section, opening hours, and an online-order call to action.
positive.expected_behavior: Save a renderable prototype in the connected Design workspace and provide a way to review it.

positive.prompt: Find a landing-page template and create a new product launch page from it.
positive.expected_behavior: Find a matching template and create a separate design based on it.

positive.prompt: Show me the designs saved in my workspace.
positive.expected_behavior: Return designs available to the connected account and handle an empty list clearly.

positive.prompt: Use the Northstar Brand design system to guide a new contact page for our product.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the saved Northstar Brand guidance and save a renderable contact-page prototype.

positive.prompt: In Product Launch Demo, make the hero headline clearer and the call to action easier to find. Keep the current layout and other sections.
positive.expected_behavior: Update the identified prototype while preserving the layout and content the user did not ask to change.

negative.prompt: Connect to my localhost app and change its checkout page code.
Deploy this prototype to production and configure working authentication and payments.
Delete every saved design and start over.

review.iframeJustification: The plugin can render the Design editor for a prototype the user has created or opened. The saved design and editor are served from the Agent-Native Design origin. The widget loads the pinned MCP Apps bridge module from esm.sh to support the open UI protocol.
